description: Rank countries by Global Peace Index score — the N most peaceful or N least peaceful countries in one call, with rank and score. PREFER for "most peaceful countries", "least peaceful/most dangerous countries", "top 10 most peaceful nations", "which countries have the worst peace ranking". direction defaults to "most_peaceful".

direction.description: Which end of the ranking to return. Default "most_peaceful".

limit.description: How many countries to return (default 10, max 50).

name: gpi_ranking
